day_shape: 80 items: Singapore-flagged container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz after mine strike with IRGC claiming closure, CENTCOM reports Oct 6 destruction of Iranian dhow, reports of US MOAB strike plans and Netanyahu pre-election Iran deliberations, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz ship sinking and blockade claims
threads.summary: A Singapore-flagged container ship sank near the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a mine, with Iran's IRGC claiming responsibility for closing the strait. CENTCOM said US forces destroyed an Iranian-affiliated dhow on Oct 6 and rejected Iran's IMO ambassador's claims of abusive US conduct toward mariners.

threads.label: US-Iran war planning and pre-election calculus
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported US military has developed strike plans against Iran including use of the GBU-43/B MOAB, and that regional diplomats say Tehran fears renewed US hostilities. US officials told Channel 12 that Netanyahu wanted to attack Iran before Israel's election, while Maariv sources said he feared electoral damage.

threads.label: Yemen-Saudi exchange of strikes
threads.summary: Defa Press cited Yemeni sources claiming a Saudi Typhoon jet was downed over Saada and 42 Saudi strikes hit Yemen in 24 hours, while Yemen's armed forces denied attacking Medina. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a drone over eastern Saudi Arabia, and humanitarian agencies reported 800,000 people cut off from aid.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF said combat engineers destroyed a 1.5km Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line in Gaza and reported 100+ militants killed and 8km of tunnels neutralised over four months in northern Gaza. Israeli forces also announced operations against two Ramallah and Yatta 'charities' accused of serving Hamas and the PFLP.

threads.label: Iran internal: economy, security incidents, protest impunity
threads.summary: Iran International reported year-on-year inflation near 90%, unemployment payment delays, and police killing two brothers aged 15 and 19 in a Tehran chase; a Basij women's commander and police officer were killed in Sistan-Baluchestan. Amnesty detailed judicial impunity for 2022 protest killings, and Iran's central bank governor dismissed US claims of economic collapse at an IMF meeting in Bangkok.

threads.label: Tehran political messaging and nuclear debate
threads.summary: Pezeshkian toured East Azerbaijan telling officials the enemy failed to exploit Iran's imbalances, while Deputy FM Khatibzadeh said in Vienna the NPT was 'on life support'. A resurfaced Zarif video dismissing pre-war nuclear deterrence drew criticism, and Iran International cited an IRGC official likening the US conflict to a 'world war'.

threads.label: Lebanon, Hezbollah and northern front
threads.summary: Defence Minister Katz threatened to seize additional territory in southern Lebanon and expand the security zone if Iran initiates war and Hezbollah joins. Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah offering $14,000 to displaced Beirut families and highlighted an EU designation gap, while CICA delegations including Iran walked out of Herzog's Baku speech.

events.title_en: General Shahid Sayed Abdulrahim Mousavi Highway ready for operation. Sections of the General Shahid Sayed Abdulrahim Mousavi (Dogas) Highway will be put into operation on Saturday, 16 October with the presence of Alireza Zakani, Tehran's mayor and a number of city managers. This highway has a length of 4 kilometres, 14.5 kilometres of access routes, 11 bridges, express and local traffic routes within the Shahid Fahmideh Expressway and Shahid Kharrazi Highway and a network for collecting and directing surface water. The operation of this section of the project will help distribute traffic load evenly in western Tehran, safely connect arterial routes and reduce traffic in the underpass area of Darupakhsh and pharmacy streets.
